meta.title: Abdullah Al Mamun | Technical Support Engineer
meta.description: Abdullah Al Mamun is a Technical Support Engineer experienced in website maintenance, IT operations, troubleshooting, and full-stack web development.

hero.title: Technical Support Engineer
hero.intro: I keep people, websites, and systems moving—combining practical IT support with hands-on web development and clear technical communication.
hero.typewriterSummary: website maintenance, full-stack development, and technical documentation.

capabilities.title: Support that connects people and technology
capabilities.intro: I bring a calm, practical approach to troubleshooting, documentation, website maintenance, and cross-team communication.
capabilities.supportBody: Diagnose hardware, software, access, and workflow problems while keeping users informed.
capabilities.troubleshootingBody: Reproduce issues, isolate root causes, document findings, and coordinate fixes with development teams.
capabilities.websiteBody: Maintain and improve HTML, CSS, and WordPress websites with attention to usability and reliability.
capabilities.systemsBody: Build practical Node.js, Express, and MySQL solutions informed by real operational needs.

experience.title: Experience built around reliability
experience.bitAppsSummary: Maintain and enhance client websites while translating user-reported problems into clear, actionable information for development teams.
experience.bitAppsBullet1: Maintain HTML, CSS, and WordPress websites.
experience.bitAppsBullet2: Reproduce, document, and report software defects.
experience.bitAppsBullet3: Create troubleshooting guides that improve support workflows.
experience.bitAppsBullet4: Coordinate technical communication between clients and internal teams.
experience.seniorSummary: Combined operational leadership with day-to-day responsibility for dependable workplace technology.
experience.seniorBullet1: Managed IT infrastructure, hardware, and software maintenance.
experience.seniorBullet2: Analyzed operational data for promotion and budget decisions.
experience.seniorBullet3: Supported continuous system availability across departments.
experience.juniorSummary: Delivered responsive technical support in a time-sensitive stock-exchange environment.
experience.juniorBullet1: Installed and maintained hardware and software for 50+ workstations.
experience.juniorBullet2: Supported data management and daily trading operations.
experience.juniorBullet3: Minimized downtime through proactive checks and rapid troubleshooting.

projects.title: 3 selected projects
projects.intro: Hands-on applications that demonstrate database design, authentication, workflow thinking, testing, and deployment.
projects.medicineAlt: Medicine packaging representing the Emergency Medicine Finder project
projects.medicineBody: A production-grade platform with three user roles, a 17-table MySQL schema, 82+ API routes, secure uploads, email verification, stock transfers, reporting, backups, and data export.
projects.houseAlt: Team collaboration representing the House Shifting Service project
projects.houseBody: A relocation workflow system for customers, workers, and administrators with role-specific dashboards, JWT authentication, request assignment, and status tracking.
projects.calculatorAlt: Mathematical notes representing the PCIU CGPA Calculator project
projects.calculatorBody: A student-focused calculator that retrieves results by ID and computes CGPA from live academic data using a Node.js and Express service.
